results = []

	basePath = "[default]agratas/sanand/zoneE/calendering/anode"

	machines = system.tag.browse(basePath)

	for machine in machines.getResults():

		machineName = machine['name']
		machinePath = str(machine['fullPath'])

		speedTag = machinePath + "/plcTags/machineSpeed"
		productTag = machinePath + "/plcTags/productId"

		speed = system.tag.readBlocking([speedTag])[0].value
		product = system.tag.readBlocking([productTag])[0].value

		results.append({
			"machineName": machineName,
			"machineSpeed": speed,
			"productId": product,
			"speedpercent": speed
		})

	return results
